[***Demographic Research***]{.journal} · 2022

\[[Article](https://doi.org/10.4054/DemRes.2022.47.19)\]

> *Using a new database on influenza mortality since 1950 at the subnational level, we identify the Hong Kong flu as a structural break. After the break, geographical differences are less explained by regional characteristics such as income, density, or aging ratio.*
